item.title: Woman Doesn’t Know Who To Believe After Best Friend Drops A Cheating Confession But Her Boyfriend Denies It
item.description: Nothing good comes out of alcohol misuse. Not only does it become detrimental to one’s health, but it can also ruin the person’s relationships in an instant. This is what happened between two women who had been friends for more than a decade, when one of them acted on her blind jealousy while intoxicated.

item.title: 79 Funny And Chaotic Marriage Memes To Send Your Partner Instead Of Paying For Couple’s Therapy
item.description: Married life is like running a marathon. Sure, you can try to sprint through it without any preparation, but then there's a good chance that you'll collapse not long after the starting line. However, if you put in the training miles and are ready to learn along the way, the experience might be entirely different. As you hit your stride, you enter a satisfying rhythm, and everything is more euphoric than painful. From silly hobbies to wholesome teamwork, these memes are funny because they're true

item.title: 93 Hilarious Memes With A Hint Of Cynicism
item.description: The same internet jokes can get stale when repeated too often. Sometimes, you get so used to ‘ordinary’ humor that you need something a bit more ‘out there’ to make you laugh. Luckily, social media is full of bizarre content to keep you amused and confused. This Facebook page is a repository for weird, random, unhinged, and slightly edgy memes, and we’ve collected the best ones to share with you. Check them out if you’re missing some chaos in your life.

item.title: “If It’s Stupid And It Works, It’s Not Stupid”: 61 Quick Fixes That Turned Out To Be Genius
item.description: Would you say that putting up fake surveillance cameras to put off potential robbers is dumb? And what about eating Cheetos with chopsticks so you don't get Cheeto fingers – is that silly too? These folks would disagree with you, as they have argued that "If it's stupid and it works, it's not stupid." Read on to find more eccentric solutions to common annoyances in this post!

item.title: Woman Refuses To Contribute $50 To A Coworker’s Retirement Gift After She Made Her Life Miserable
item.description: "She was horrible to me for years," a woman complained, saying she had no intention to contribute to her rude coworker's going away gift. The entire office and the manager pressured her into pitching in with $50, but she disliked the colleague so much that she flat out refused. They accused her of holding a grudge and being petty, but she still didn't let up.

item.title: 49 Things Countries Have That Just Make Sense And Everyone Else Should Take Notes
item.description: From dedicated bike highways to Braille menus in McDonald's, some cities and countries are really coming to the party with the most genius ideas. People have been sharing the things that made them think, "this makes sense!" whether home or abroad, and much of the list reads like a playbook for the perfect country.

item.title: 71 Times Tech Support Workers Wish They Had Chosen A Different Profession (New Pics)
item.description: “What could possibly go wrong?” is a question many of us have learned to avoid asking, especially at work. And it’s no different for tech support folk. These girls and guys are trained to handle all sorts of issues, from minor glitches to massive malfunctions, and they often carry out their duties by figuring out […]

item.title: “HItchhikers May Be Escaping Inmates”: 76 Of The Scariest Signs Ever Spotted In The Wild (New Pics)
item.description: Signs are generally supposed to be dull, simple and easy to read. So when one’s contents inspire dread instead of clarity, it’s either worked too well or someone really just overdid it. We’ve gathered some of the creepiest signs netizens have seen and shared online.

item.title: 55 Shocking Moments When Medical Misogyny Put Women’s Health At Risk
item.description: Going to the doctor should be simple: explain what’s wrong, get help, go home. But for many women, getting proper treatment means first having to prove they’re not overreacting or imagining things. Some surveys suggest 2 out of 3 have faced medical misogyny—from years-long missed diagnoses to being told symptoms are “normal,” while male patients are taken more seriously. Online, women are sharing what happened, and the stories are outrageous to read.

item.title: 45 Ridiculously Funny Valentine’s Day Gifts That Show True Love Means Making Each Other Laugh
item.description: Valentine’s Day is almost here, which means the yearly avalanche of heart-shaped chocolates, overpriced roses, impossible dinner reservations, and a sea of red and pink is back. It’s romantic, sure—but also pretty predictable. So these folks ditched flowers and candy and went for gifts that made their loved ones laugh out loud instead, and those ended up stealing the spotlight. We rounded up the funniest ones for some last-minute inspiration today.
